newsitem.title: USA: Workgroup, Siemens to integrate products.
newsitem.headline: Workgroup, Siemens to integrate products.

text.p: Workgroup Technology Corp said on Wednesday it will team with Siemens AG's Industrial and Building Systems Group to integrate Workgroup's CMS software with Siemens' SAPs R/3 software.
The intent is to create a product that allows customers to electronically manage their product information from the conceptual-model stage through all manufacturing phases, Workgroup said.

Workgroup's CMS manages the actual work outputs, or deliverables, of various professionals throughout the product lifecycle, the company said. SAPs R/3 models a range of business processes, especially for manufacturing.
